checks.name: readme-example
checks.cmd: out=$(docker run --rm --entrypoint theHarvester ghcr.io/laramies/theharvester:latest -d example.com -b crtsh,certspotter 2>&1); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q 'www.example.com' || { echo "source-health: crtsh=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 20 'https://crt.sh/?q=example.com&output=json') certspotter=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 20 'https://api.certspotter.com/v1/issuances?domain=example.com&include_subdomains=true&expand=dns_names')"; exit 1; }
checks.note: self-diagnosing: on an empty result it probes the upstream sources, so a crt.sh 502 is classified NET/UPSTREAM instead of a bogus install FAIL
